create_cosmos2_text2image_pipeline: create a Cosmos2TextToImagePipeline from pretrained model for text-to-image generation
run_cosmos2_text2image_generation: run text-to-image generation with prompt, negative prompt, height, width, and guidance scale
encode_cosmos2_text_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with max sequence length and classifier-free guidance
prepare_cosmos2_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents with configurable batch size, dimensions, and device for denoising
retrieve_cosmos2_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from custom timesteps, sigmas, or num_inference_steps configuration
